dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge with a deep falcation beginning approximately 30% down from the apex and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius; categorized as obtuse-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a variable slope, beginning at approximately 35 degrees at the anterior base and steepening to 55 degrees toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.9:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark horizontal oblong patch is visible on the central-lower lateral surface of the fin; minor white depigmentation spots are present along the anterior base edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark oval marking on the mid-body of the fin surface.
